aging.indicativeDisclaimer: Indicative only: converted at the rate frozen on each invoice, not revalued. Amounts in different currencies are never added together elsewhere in this report.

aging.explain.title: How this report is calculated
aging.explain.days: Days past due are calendar days from the {basis} to the as-of date, in your organization's timezone.
aging.explain.buckets: Each open invoice lands in exactly one bucket. A boundary day belongs to the bucket that ends on it: 30 days is "1–30", 31 days is "31–60". Boundaries come from your organization settings.
aging.explain.openBalance: The amount shown is what is still owed on the invoice (total minus payments allocated, credit notes applied, tax withheld and approved write-offs), not the invoice total. A fully settled invoice is not shown.
aging.explain.asOf: For a past date, balances are rebuilt from the dated history of payments and credits, so the same date always gives the same report, whatever happened later.
aging.explain.currencies: Each currency has its own table. The base-currency total is indicative, converted at the rate recorded on each invoice.
aging.explain.unapplied: Cash received but not yet allocated, and credit notes not yet applied, are shown below the table and never inside a bucket.
